{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Drop refunded orders since they should not be counted in conversion rate
# Conversion is defined as completed checkout, so only 'completed' status counts
df_filtered = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Now compute conversion rate by channel
conversion_by_channel = df_filtered.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Extract the conversion rates
email_rate = conversion_by_channel['email']
paid_search_rate = conversion_by_channel['paid_search']

effect = email_rate - paid_search_rate

print(f"Email conversion rate: {email_rate}")
print(f"Paid search conversion rate: {paid_search_rate}")
print(f"Effect (email - paid search): {effect}")"}
